environment.description: Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (REST API) with public endpoint. Lambda proxy integration passes raw JSON body to handler. No request validation template configured. IAM authorization disabled (open endpoint with API key only). DynamoDB table contains PII (SSN, addresses, payment tokens). Lambda execution role has dynamodb:Scan permission on the table with no condition keys.

config.api_gateway: REST API, public endpoint, no request body validation
config.auth: API key only (x-api-key header), no IAM/Cognito
config.network: Lambda in default VPC, API Gateway publicly routable
